archetype: Archetype 3 (Pastel & Soft) mixed with Neo-Brutalist Vibrant Play
description: A modern, youth-focused social messaging app and hotel dashboard. It uses a 'Neo-Brutalist' aesthetic to balance approachability (pastels) with high energy (vibrant accents and hard shadows), avoiding the generic corporate or childish looks.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use TypeScript files (.tsx), use standard JavaScript (.js or .jsx) as defined in the environment.
Do not use generic fonts like Inter. Import 'Cabinet Grotesk' or 'Outfit' for headings and 'DM Sans' for body text from Google Fonts.
Implement the 'Neo-Brutalist' aesthetic heavily. This means solid black borders (`border-2 border-black` or `border-[#0A0A0A]`) on cards, buttons, and inputs.
Use solid hard shadows `shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(10,10,10,1)]` instead of standard blurred drop shadows for all interactive elements to maintain the vibrant youth vibe.
For the chat interfaces, ensure clear visual distinction between user messages (greenish), other guests (white), and reception/AI (peach/orange) using the defined surface colors.
Never center-align long blocks of text or chat messages. Keep them left-aligned for readability.
Ensure the Admin Dashboard has a dense but structured bento-box grid layout using the neo-brutalist cards.

Mandatory: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, chat bubbles, navigation links) MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted in kebab-case based on their role (e.g., data-testid='chat-send-button', data-testid='qr-login-input').
Do not use transparent headers without a blur or solid background. The mobile app top nav should be a sticky glass header.
For Shadcn components, override their default soft aesthetic to match the hard borders and solid colors defined in this guideline.
